units.source_text: 六条夫人多情善感，写此信时，几度搁笔长叹，方得写成。

en.t: Lady Rokujo was deeply emotional and sensitive, and while writing this letter she several times laid down her brush and sighed at length before she was finally able to finish it.

units.source_text: 用白色中国纸四五张不拘行格，笔情墨趣异常优美。

en.t: She used four or five sheets of white Chinese paper, paying no attention to fixed lines or format, and the feeling of the brushwork and the charm of the ink were extraordinarily beautiful.
